methods.name: api.describe
methods.summary: Every method, its parameters, what it answers and an example: this documentation as JSON.

methods.name: api.ping
methods.summary: Answers at once: whether the API is there and which version it speaks.

methods.name: app.info
methods.summary: The app's version, the device, whether it is the default texting app, and who is signed in where.

methods.name: app.log
methods.summary: The newest lines of the Developer log (Settings › Developer).

methods.name: app.prefs.get
methods.summary: The person's choices as the app keeps them: one by its key, or all whose keys start with a prefix (all of them with none given).

methods.name: app.prefs.set
methods.summary: Sets one of the person's choices, as Settings would. Some take effect only once the screen they belong to is opened again.

params.name: value
params.doc: Its value: on/off for a switch.

methods.name: app.update
methods.summary: Where the app's own update stands: the version installed, any newer one, and whether it is downloading.

methods.name: contacts.get
methods.summary: Who a number is, as the phone's contacts have them.

methods.name: conversations.archive
methods.summary: Archives a conversation, or brings it back.

params.name: archived
params.doc: true to archive, false to bring back.

methods.name: conversations.delete
methods.summary: Deletes a conversation from the phone, for every app. It cannot be undone.

methods.name: conversations.draft
methods.summary: What is half written in a conversation; with "text", sets it.

methods.name: conversations.get
methods.summary: One conversation by its number.

methods.name: conversations.list
methods.summary: Conversations of texts (and RCS beside Google Messages), newest first, a page at a time.

params.name: offset
params.doc: Where to start: the "next" a page gave.

methods.name: conversations.markRead
methods.summary: Marks a conversation read (in Google Messages too, beside it).

methods.name: conversations.messages
methods.summary: A conversation's messages, newest first: texts, picture messages and RCS, with their state and attachments.

methods.name: conversations.mute
methods.summary: Mutes a conversation's notifications, or unmutes them.

methods.name: conversations.pin
methods.summary: Pins a conversation to the top of the list, or unpins it.

methods.name: conversations.rename
methods.summary: Names a group conversation here (empty takes the name away).

methods.name: conversations.threadFor
methods.summary: The conversation's number for these people, made if there is none yet.

methods.name: filters.classify
methods.summary: What the filters make of a text from someone: its tags (spam, its kind) and the section it would go to.

params.name: text
params.example: Your package could not be delivered. Reschedule: bit.ly/3xYz

params.name: contact
params.doc: Whether they are in your contacts.

example.text: Congratulations! You've won a gift card. Claim now: http://prize.example/win

methods.name: friends.list
methods.summary: Friends by username, those who asked you, and those you asked; with whether each is on.

methods.name: messages.delete
methods.summary: Deletes one message from the phone by its kind and id (as conversations.messages gives them).

methods.name: messages.send
methods.summary: Sends a text to these people, as the app would (RCS beside Google Messages where the conversation is RCS).

methods.name: net.status
methods.summary: The app's routes to other installs: this install's name, the relay server it uses, how each route stands, and who it can reach.

methods.name: networks.changeGroup
methods.summary: Changes a group on its network: any of title, description, timer (seconds), add, remove, admin, unadmin (lists of ids), announcementsOnly.

params.name: chat
params.doc: The chat's id on that network (networks.chats gives them).

methods.name: networks.chats
methods.summary: A network's chats, newest first.

methods.name: networks.group
methods.summary: A group in full: its name, description, timer, people and rules, and what you may change.

params.name: chat
params.doc: The chat's id on that network (networks.chats gives them).

methods.name: networks.list
methods.summary: The other networks: whether each is signed in, and as whom.

methods.name: networks.markRead
methods.summary: Marks a chat read on its network.

params.name: chat
params.doc: The chat's id on that network (networks.chats gives them).

methods.name: networks.messages
methods.summary: A chat's messages as held, oldest first; loaded from the network first.

params.name: chat
params.doc: The chat's id on that network (networks.chats gives them).

methods.name: networks.react
methods.summary: Puts a reaction on a message, or takes it off.

params.name: chat
params.doc: The chat's id on that network (networks.chats gives them).

methods.name: networks.reply
methods.summary: Sends words as a reply quoting one of the chat's messages.

params.name: chat
params.doc: The chat's id on that network (networks.chats gives them).

params.name: message
params.doc: The id of the message answered.

methods.name: networks.send
methods.summary: Sends words in a chat on that network.

params.name: chat
params.doc: The chat's id on that network (networks.chats gives them).

methods.name: plugins.devInstall
methods.summary: Loads a plugin you are making (a ghost-plugin/1 file) on this phone, unreviewed, as Settings › Developer › Plugins in development does. Developer mode only. dryRun checks it without loading it.

params.name: pack
params.doc: The plugin file's JSON. Give this or text.

params.name: text
params.doc: The plugin file's words, as they are on disk. Give this or pack.

params.name: on
params.doc: Switch it on once loaded: only where you agreed on the phone to everything it can do already (false where not given).

params.name: dryRun
params.doc: Only check it: what is wrong with it, if anything.

methods.returns: {"ok": bool, "id": "bills", "plugin": "xbills", "on": bool, "needs": "consent on the phone" (where on was asked and could not be), "issues": [{"code", "path", "message", "severity"}...]}

methods.name: plugins.devRemove
methods.summary: Removes a plugin in development from this phone.

params.name: id
params.doc: Its id, as in its file.

methods.name: plugins.list
methods.summary: Every plugin, whether it is on, and its own choices: the built-in ones and those from the Marketplace and in development (whose ids start with x).

methods.name: plugins.pref
methods.summary: One of a plugin's own choices (the spam filter's strictness, a sign on or off); with "value", sets it.

methods.name: plugins.set
methods.summary: Turns a plugin on or off.

methods.name: presence.get
methods.summary: Whether someone is on now, and where, or when they were last seen: a number, a friend's @username, or network:id (Telegram).

params.name: address
params.doc: A phone number, @username, or telegram:<user id>.

methods.name: ui.compose
methods.summary: Opens New message, with words already written where given.

methods.name: ui.home
methods.summary: Closes what is open and goes back to the list of conversations.

methods.name: ui.openChat
methods.summary: Opens a Telegram or Signal chat on the screen.

params.name: chat
params.doc: The chat's id on that network (networks.chats gives them).

methods.name: ui.openConversation
methods.summary: Opens a conversation of texts on the screen.

methods.name: ui.openSettings
methods.summary: Opens Settings, at one of its sections where given (messages, sounds, developer, api, ...). plugins and plugin-<id> open the Marketplace instead.

methods.name: ui.toast
methods.summary: Shows a short note at the foot of the screen.
